overview.Name: Enovix Corporation
overview.Description: Enovix Corporation designs, develops, and manufactures lithium-ion battery cells in the United States and internationally. It serves wearables and IoT, smartphone, computing, electrical vehicles, and original equipment manufacturers. The company was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Fremont, California.
